question: How to obtain time-specific questions for evaluation (manual annotation vs synthetic generation) and ensure they accurately reflect temporal information needs?
description: The quality of evaluation depends on having questions that require knowing the correct version of a clause at a specific time. We need to decide on a strategy to gather or create such questions.
rationale: If questions are not truly time-dependent, the temporal relevance component may not be effectively tested. We must investigate existing temporal QA datasets and annotation practices.
